actual_use: Original surface proof of the spin-structure/quadratic-refinement correspondence and its naturality; exact normalization for the receiving Arf calculation.
hypotheses_and_normalization_check: Johnson’s spin class evaluates1 on the fibre class z. The quadratic lift of an embedded circle is its tangential lift plus z, so q is not the raw spin-class evaluation on the tangent lift. The additional z makes the bounding-disc circle have q=0 and the Lie circle q=1. Theorem1B produces the intersection term; Theorem3A gives the affine bijection. The receiving closed oriented torus and mod-two coefficients satisfy all hypotheses.
extent: The complete nine-page original was read in extracted text, with the operative p.371 equations and proofs visually checked. No appeal to the analytic theta-parity theorem is required.
